title: Employee Handbook
text:
# Employee Handbook

## Purpose

This employee handbook describes working conditions at Nordia Systems. It applies to every employee in all departments.

## Working hours

Standard working hours at Nordia Systems are 9:00 to 17:00. Employees take a one hour lunch break.

## Remote work

Employees may work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval.

## Dress code

Business casual clothing is expected in client-facing meetings.

title: Leave Policy
text:
# Leave Policy

## Annual leave

Every full-time employee receives 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

## Carry over

Employees may carry over a maximum of 5 unused leave days into the following year.

## Requests

Leave requests must be submitted at least two weeks in advance through the HR portal.

## Sick leave

Sick leave of more than three consecutive days requires a medical certificate.

title: Recruitment Policy
text:
# Recruitment Policy

## Process

Every vacancy is published internally for ten working days before external advertising.

## Interviews

Each candidate is interviewed by at least two people, including one member of the hiring department.

## Probation

New hires serve a probation period of three months, extendable once by three months.

## References

Reference checks are performed only after a written offer is accepted by the candidate.

title: Password Policy

## Length

Passwords must contain at least 8 characters including upper case, lower case and digits.

## Rotation

title: IT Security Policy
text:
# IT Security Policy

## Network

The production network is segmented into three zones: public, internal and restricted.

## Patching

Critical security patches must be deployed within 72 hours of release.

## Backups

Backups of production databases run every night at 02:00 and are retained for 35 days.

## Incident reporting

Any suspected security incident must be reported to the IT security desk within one hour.

title: Incident Report 2026-03
text:
# Incident Report 2026-03

## Summary

On 14 March 2026 a phishing email led to the compromise of one employee mailbox at Nordia Systems.

## Root cause

The root cause was a missing multi-factor authentication policy on the legacy mail gateway.

## Impact

No customer data was exfiltrated. Approximately 40 internal emails were read by the attacker.

## Remediation

MFA was enforced on all mail accounts and the legacy gateway was decommissioned on 21 March.

facts.question: What was the root cause of the March 2026 phishing incident?
facts.answer: missing multi-factor authentication policy on the legacy mail gateway

facts.question: When was the legacy mail gateway decommissioned?

title: Infrastructure Documentation
text:
# Infrastructure Documentation

## Hosting

Production workloads run on a three-node Kubernetes cluster hosted in the Tunis data center.

## Database

The primary PostgreSQL database replicates synchronously to a standby in a second availability zone.

## Monitoring

Metrics are collected by Prometheus and alerts are routed to the on-call engineer.

## Disaster recovery

The recovery time objective for core services is four hours and the recovery point objective is fifteen minutes.
